caption_L1: Poverty rate in Poland from 2008 to 2019 is a line diagram. The y-axis shows Extreme poverty (subsistence minimum) using linear scale with a minimum of 0.00 and a maximum of 0.08 while the x-axis plots Year with linear scale with a minimum of 2008 and a maximum of 2018.
caption_L2L3: Between 2008 and 2013, the extreme poverty (subsistence minimum) rate in Poland grew from just below 0.06 to between 0.07 and 0.08.  It remained at that level between 2013 and 2014, but fell over the next three years to 2017 to a low of slightly above 0.04. 2018 saw a slight increase again in extreme poverty levels, but in 2019 it fell back to levels seen in 2017.
